claims.text: 8 km off Townsville, about half an hour by ferry
Over half national park, roughly 7 km by 5 km, about 25 km of walking tracks
Four villages up east coast, Picnic Bay to Horseshoe Bay
Bays from patrolled family beaches to quiet coves with coral close to shore
Swim and paddle at Horseshoe Bay (stinger net in summer, calm water, kayaking, paddleboarding)
Snorkel coral in quiet coves (Florence, Radical Bay)
Walk the national park tracks
Ferry about 30 min from South Townsville to Nelly Bay; cars carried; buses link bays
Stinger net at Horseshoe Bay in summer, swim inside it
Outside the net, stinger suits are advised during stinger season
claims.fix: Wikivoyage mentions suits only as tour equipment. Drop the sentence or end the tip at 'swim inside it'.

claims.text: bestMonths 5-10; 'no stinger season' in blurb
claims.fix: Not stated for the island. Based on the Cairns page (stinger season Oct-May, wet Dec-Mar), which is a different part of the coast. The island is in the drier Townsville region. Keep May-Oct but label it inferred, or have the owner confirm from a Townsville source; the 'drier weather' wording is safer than 'no stinger season'.

claims.text: Town of about 4,500 on the Bruce Highway, Italian heritage from sugar-cane migrants
TYTO Wetlands have an observation tower and boardwalks
Visitor centre on Cooper Street is the base for the district
claims.fix: Page only lists the centre (44 Cooper St, daily 9-4). Say 'the visitor centre is on Cooper Street'.

claims.text: Wallaman Falls near Ingham
claims.fix: Wikipedia: Shire of Hinchinbrook, 268 m main drop (Australia's tallest single drop). Wikivoyage Ingham does not mention it.

claims.text: Stand at the top of Wallaman Falls
claims.fix: No source read says there is a top lookout; QPWS blocked. Reword to 'See Australia's tallest single-drop waterfall' (supported by Wikipedia) or leave for QPWS confirmation.

claims.text: Creek swimming holes / Swim in rainforest creek holes (Jourama Falls, Big Crystal Creek)
claims.fix: No fetched source mentions swimming at these. QPWS blocked. Confirm or reword/drop.

claims.text: Thorsborne Trail: Hinchinbrook Island walk; trailheads reached from Ingham
claims.fix: Wikipedia: 32 km, east coast of Hinchinbrook Island, 40 hikers a day, access by private ferry from Cardwell (Ramsay Bay) or Lucinda (George Point). Description 'trailheads' is loose: say the trail is reached by ferry from Cardwell or Lucinda, not from Ingham.

claims.text: Ingham about 75-80 min north of Townsville, three hours south of Cairns, Brisbane-Cairns coaches stop
Info centre daily 9am-4pm, western end of town near TYTO
bestMonths 5-10 and 'drier, cooler weather before the heavy summer rain'
claims.fix: Inferred from the page's climate chart (Jun-Sep 35-45 mm, Feb 480 mm; Oct 54, Nov 114), not a stated recommendation. Chart supports it.

checks.whyVisit: 4 ok; 'Day trip to Kuranda and the Daintree' does NOT start with an action verb

claims.text: City of about 150,000 on Trinity Bay, tourism main industry
Reef trips, dive and snorkel tours, rafting and scenic flights leave from here
claims.fix: Reef, dive, rafting, skydiving are on the page. 'Scenic flights' rests on the 'Aerial activities' heading; skydiving is explicit. Safe to say 'skydives'.

claims.text: Kuranda and Daintree are day trips away
Free lagoon pool and barbecues on Esplanade; swimming beaches north and south
Set out for the Great Barrier Reef
Cool off in the Esplanade Lagoon
Day trip to Kuranda and the Daintree
claims.fix: Starts with 'Day', not a verb. Fix: 'Take a day trip to Kuranda and the Daintree'; 7 words OK.

claims.text: Raft rivers or skydive from the air
Stinger season about October to May; nets at Holloways, Yorkey's Knob, Trinity, Kewarra, Palm Cove, Ellis
claims.fix: Tip detail is 176 chars: shorten to under 160, for example 'From about October to May, swim only inside net enclosures or the free Esplanade Lagoon. Nets are at Palm Cove, Trinity and Holloways beaches, among others.'

claims.text: Cyclones Dec-Mar damage infrastructure, stop public activities
Peak season June-August, first two weeks of July busiest; book tours and rental cars in advance
claims.fix: Peak dates supported. The advice to book in advance is not on the page: cut the last sentence or label it a general tip.

claims.text: bestMonths 5-10, 'dry, outside wet season and stinger season'
claims.fix: Not stated on the page: derived from wet Dec-Mar, stinger Oct-May. Note stinger season runs to October, so 'outside stinger season' is true only for May-Sep wording is off: use 'dry and mostly outside stinger season'. Also peak season June-Aug is the crowded time.

claims.text: Small village beside Barron Gorge National Park, about 40 minutes by road from Cairns
claims.fix: Page says 'around half an hour' in the intro and ~40 minutes in Get in; 40 is fine.

claims.text: Scenic Railway climbs 329 m over 34 km
Skyrail gondola over the rainforest canopy
Markets, Birdworld, butterfly sanctuary and Koala Gardens in the village
Barron Falls can be seen from the railway
claims.fix: Page: Barron Falls railway platform, reachable by car too. Also 'Barron Gorge walks, 3 km from town'. Wikipedia: Din Din, 137 m.

claims.text: Watch Barron Falls from the lookouts
claims.fix: Fetched pages mention a railway platform and gorge walks, not named lookouts. Reword 'Watch Barron Falls from the railway platform' or 'Walk to Barron Gorge'. Note the falls are a trickle in the dry season (Wikivoyage, Wikipedia) so it clashes with the May-Oct best months.

claims.text: Many take railway up and Skyrail down or reverse; carriages not air-conditioned; booking recommended
Village and markets packed midday; arrive early or stay later
claims.fix: Packed at midday supported. Markets close about when the last train leaves (3:30pm), so 'stay later' is weak: say 'arrive early'.

claims.text: bestMonths 5-10, drier and rainforest walks easier
claims.fix: Inferred from Cairns wet season, no Kuranda statement.

claims.text: Plateau behind Cairns, volcanic activity over millions of years
Lake Eacham and Lake Barrine are maar volcanoes
Remnant rainforest in national parks holds twelve endemic bird species
claims.fix: Page: twelve species endemic to the Tablelands and the ranges just south. Add 'and the nearby ranges' or say 'twelve regional endemic species'.

claims.text: Millaa Millaa Falls, Millstream Falls, Curtain Fig Tree, Herberton mining town
claims.fix: Curtain Fig Tree is an individual strangler fig (Wikipedia). Herberton tin mining supported. 'Drive-it-yourself loop' is not sourced; page only says a car is best.

claims.text: Swim in volcanic crater lakes
claims.fix: Page lists Lake Eacham/Barrine with no text about swimming. QPWS blocked. Confirm or reword to 'Walk around volcanic crater lakes'.

claims.text: See waterfalls tumble in the hills
Stand beneath giant strangler figs
claims.fix: Strangler fig supported for Curtain Fig Tree (Wikipedia). 'Giant' size not on the Wikivoyage page.

claims.text: Reached from Cairns by State Route 52 or National Route 1; need a car
Allow a full day or stay overnight in Yungaburra or Atherton
claims.fix: Both towns have lodging listings, but 'allow a full day' is not stated. Soften or cut.

claims.text: Important Bird Area; golden bowerbird and tooth-billed bowerbird found nowhere else
claims.fix: Both are in the endemic list for the area and the ranges just south; 'found nowhere else' is OK only with 'nowhere else but the nearby ranges' or say 'endemic to the region'.

claims.text: Wet season runs December to March, when waterfalls are fullest but roads and walks can be affected
claims.fix: The Dec-Mar season is from the Cairns page. 'Waterfalls fullest' is not on the Tablelands page (Wikipedia notes it only for Barron Falls), and 'roads and walks affected' is unsourced. Cut to 'The wet season runs December to March, with heavy rain.'

claims.text: bestMonths 5-10
claims.fix: Inferred from the regional wet season; the Tablelands page has no best-time text.
